game.desc: The Zero Knuckle... the baddest new tool in Zero's arsenal lets you steal enemies' weapons and use them in battle. Employ this along with countless other cool moves to fight the Neo Arcadian army, defeat the evil Dr. Weil and help the caravan of humans reach the peace and security of Area Zero.

game.desc:
It is the year 22XX...
The legendary heroes of the Reploids, X and Zero, defeated the evil Sigma long ago, and a new army was created to prevent outbreaks of the Maverick Virus. But as time went on, the army became oppressive, and began to deal out a paranoid brand of justice. It is said that their leader, once a great warrior, has become cold and calculating, eliminating any Reploid that dares oppose him.
A hero is needed in these dark times, and that is exactly what Ciel and her rebel group have found in an old ruin...a hero from the past, reborn in the future.
Zero has come into a time he does not know, to save it from a figure of the past...the fate of freedom rests on his shoulders.
game.name: Rockman Zero 洛克人Z1

game.desc:
The mighty robot King has taken over Dr. Wily's base, invaded the Robot Museum, and stolen 100 CDs containing secret robot plans, hoping to create the ultimate unstoppable army of robots! And to make matters worse, he's sent 8 robot masters to prove his new-found power!
Mega Man is the only one who can stop him...or so he thought! Bass, Dr. Wily's greatest creation and Mega Man's sworn rival, is actually fighting ALONGSIDE Mega Man for once! Of course, it's only to prove that he's the strongest robot ever made, and he'll do it by smashing King's army of mechanical maniacs!
Now, Mega Man and Bass are heading out to get back all of the CD's that King stole. Run, jump, slide, dash, and blast your way through to destroy this new menace!
game.name: Rockman & Forte 洛克人與佛魯迪

game.desc: 故事發生在《天空之劍》之後、《四人之劍》之前，揭開了傳說聖劍四神劍（Four Sword）的誕生由來。海拉魯王國正在舉辦慶祝「皮克爾節」的百年武術大會。然而，大會冠軍——神祕的魔術師古夫（Vaati）心懷鬼胎，他不但當場黑化打破了封印魔物的「皮克爾之劍」，釋放了無數妖魔，更施展黑魔法將薩爾達公主變成了石頭。為了拯救公主、重鑄聖劍，國王派出了年輕的鐵匠學徒林克前往傳說中只有純真孩童才能看見的皮克爾森林。半路上，林克解救了一頂會說話的神祕魔法帽——艾塞羅（Ezlo）。艾塞羅成為林克的夥伴（也就是林克頭上那頂招牌綠帽），賦予林克「身體縮小」的能力。林克必須穿梭在人類的龐大世界與皮克爾族的微觀世界之間，收集四大元素重鑄聖劍。

game.desc: 最初是2004年計畫在GBA平台推出的正統續作，當年找不到發行商而被迫腰斬，僅留下一個未完工的DEMO。睽違20年後，原班人馬找回當年的GBA開發工具重新將其完全復活！實體卡匣於2025年4月率先限量發售，隨後於8月正式登陸Switch、PC(Steam)、PS5、PS4與Xbox等現代平台。劇情承接2002年的GBC初代香緹，發生在二代之前，香緹的宿敵——女海盜里絲琦．布茲（Risky Boots）打算透過「旋轉並拼接整個亮片大陸（Sequin Land）」，將原本位於內陸的繁華城鎮移位到海岸邊，好讓她的海盜船隊能夠輕而易舉地登陸洗劫。香緹如一代可以用長髮鞭打敵人，並能透過跳肚皮舞變身成6種不同的動物型態進行解謎。
game.name: Shantae Advance:Risky Revolution 香緹-里絲琦的革命
